limitations: This independent basalt comparison has T1523.15K and P500/1000bar. It does not by itself validate BSE peridotite at2173.15K and270bar.
All10 dry oxides are retained in the mole denominator. Fe is represented by starting FeO-total: run-specific Fe redox and reported Fe loss are preserved but not fitted away.
KFT measures total H2O-equivalent water. NIR glass OH and molecularH2O partitions are retained separately; quenched-glass speciation is not declared in-situ melt speciation.
Ideal partial pressure and Zhang-Duan2009 fugacity are separate evaluations, neither reproduces the original Pitzer-Sterner/Aranovich-Newton recipe.
The numerical spread of unfitted residuals is an observed discrepancy, not a statistical prediction interval or bound on unmeasured T/P/composition/speciation errors.
No H2 molecular standard, metal model or native MELTS water term is changed; accepted coupled material domain remains unestablished.
